mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, avatar, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, avatar, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, avatar, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted = 0 AND id != #{excludeId}
